Definition: properly, to shake off, i.e. (figuratively) to agitate (as with fear)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to tremble, quiver, quake, be in terror; 1a) (Qal) to tremble, quake; 1b) (Pilpel); 1b1) to shake violently; 1b2) to cause to tremble
